contract: external anchoring of sealed trail heads, [audit.anchor] — docs/CONTRACTS.md section 15
statement_digest: sha256 over the statement's canonical JSON (keys sorted, no whitespace): the canonicaliser the chain hashes with
anchored_when: a chained trail writes session_end: every sealed trail, checkpoints included; queued at seal, delivered after the session's checkpoint, never on the turn path
receipts: <anchors dir>/receipts.jsonl, one line per delivered statement

git.line: one statement per line, canonical JSON
git.push: fast-forward only, never forced; the remote's receive.denyNonFastForwards and receive.denyDeletes (or a protected branch) are what make it append-only
git.protected_namespace: refs/heads/ — git's receive.denyNonFastForwards and receive.denyDeletes apply there only (a forced push to refs/gnomon/anchors was accepted with both set); a ref elsewhere is reported as a problem

rfc3161.verified_offline: imprint, nonce at delivery, signed attributes, signature under tsa_cert or a certificate it issued (one level, EKU timeStamping, valid at genTime)
rfc3161.not_verified: revocation, chains longer than one level, policy OIDs

verify_exit_1: a declared block that cannot work
absent: no [audit.anchor]: nothing queued, nothing scheduled, nothing excluded from the record guard, no network
